channel.title: noyalib: High-Performance Data & YAML Engine for Rust, WebAssembly & AI
channel.description: noyalib is a high-performance data & YAML engine written in 100% safe Rust featuring zero-copy SIMD parsing, parallel Rayon streaming, WebAssembly runtime, Model Context Protocol (MCP) AI server, and LSP support. 100% YAML Test Suite compliant.
